_help.flightBase: Seconds every thrown seed spends in the air, however short the throw.
_help.flightPerHex: Extra seconds in the air for each hex it travels.
_help.arcHeight: How high the seed arcs, as a share of the throw distance. 0 = flat.
_help.seedSize: Size of the flying seed, in hex sizes.
_help.hopHeight: How high the glyphling hops as it throws, in hex sizes.
_help.hopTime: How long the throwing hop takes, in seconds.
_help.growTime: How long the runeblossom takes to grow out of the ground, in seconds.
_help.growFrom: How small the runeblossom starts when it sprouts (0.1 = a tiny sprout, 1 = full size).
_help.pulseTime: How long one pulse of a planned piece's halo takes, in seconds.
_help.wordGlowTime: How long after a seed lands the garden stays clear before the handoff box or the end-of-game reveal may cover it, when the cast scores nothing (or word indicators are off), in seconds. A cast that scores waits for its whole score sequence instead.
_help.spotlightHold: Word spotlight, while aiming: when the aimed seed would make 2 or more words, they light up ONE at a time (QUA +4 → TAB +5 → round again). This is how long each word stays lit, in seconds. (One word just stays lit.) After Cast the words score in this same order — see the Score sequence.
_help.spotlightFade: Word spotlight: how long each word takes to fade in and to fade out, in seconds — while aiming, and as each word takes its turn in the score sequence. The next word starts after the last one has faded, so only one is ever lit. Reduce motion = no fade (the words just step).
_help.revealTangles: End of game: how long the tangled glyphlings pulse before the bonuses are shown, in seconds.
_help.revealBonus: End of game: time for each "+3" tangle bonus to pop on a rival piece, in seconds (they pop one hex at a time).
_help.revealCount: End of game: time for each player's Magic to count up (lowest first), including a short pause after, in seconds.
_help.revealWinner: End of game: how long "Grand Glyphtender!" shows before the end table opens, in seconds.
_help.revealPopTime: How long one "+3" takes to pop in (grow past full size and settle), in seconds.
_help.moveBase: Seconds every glyphling move takes to glide to its new hex, however short the move.
_help.movePerHex: Extra seconds of gliding for each hex the glyphling travels.
_help.moveSettle: How far a gliding glyphling slides past its new hex before settling back, in hex sizes. 0 = no bounce.
_help.scorePopDelay: Score sequence (word indicators on): seconds after a seed lands before the first word starts scoring.
_help.scoreWordTime: Score sequence: the words score ONE AT A TIME (outline + word bubble, its seeds pop their points, the points fly to the glyphling). This is the time each word gets, in seconds — a long word may take a little longer, because the next word waits until its last point has arrived in the total.
_help.scorePopGap: Score sequence: seconds between one seed's "+1" / "+2" popping and the next (they ripple along the word) — and between one point arriving in the glyphling's total and the next.
_help.scorePopTime: Score sequence: how long one "+1" / "+2" takes to pop in over its seed (grow past full size and settle), in seconds. The glyphling's total pops this fast too each time points arrive.
_help.scorePopHold: Score sequence: how long a word's pops stay over its seeds before they fly to the glyphling, in seconds.
_help.scoreFlyTime: Score sequence: how long each point takes to fly from its seed into the glyphling's running total, in seconds.
_help.scoreTotalHold: Score sequence: after the last word, how long the final total ("+12") and the last word stay before fading, in seconds.
_help.scoreTotalFade: Score sequence: how long the final total, the last word's outline and its bubble take to fade away, in seconds. Only then does the next turn (or the handoff box) start.
_help.scoreTotalGrow: Score sequence: how much bigger the glyphling's running total gets for every point that flies in (0.05 = 5% per point), so a big turn ends with a big number. Capped by Total: biggest size.
_help.scoreTotalMaxGrow: Score sequence: the most the running total can grow, so huge turns stay on the board (0.8 = up to 80% bigger than its starting size).
_help.turnPulseTime: Whose turn: how long one slow pulse of the current player's glyphlings takes, in seconds (they pulse until one is moved). How much they swell: feel.json → turnPulse.
_help.noShakeTime: "No" shake: how long the quick sideways shake takes when you tap something you can't move, in seconds. How far it moves: feel.json → noShake.
_help.refreshShrinkTime: Refresh: how long each set-aside seed takes to shrink away, in seconds.
_help.refreshGrowTime: Refresh: how long each new seed takes to grow into its slot (swelling a little past full size, then settling), in seconds. How much it swells: feel.json → refreshGrow.
_help.refreshStagger: Refresh: seconds between one slot starting and the next (they go one after another, left to right).
_help.refreshPause: Refresh: the pause between the last seed shrinking away and the new ones growing in, in seconds. Play passes to the next player only after they've grown.
_help.trailLead: Turn trails: when another player's turn is replayed online, how long their trail takes to draw on (from ring → dotted path → to ring → target ring) before their glyphling glides, in seconds. Reduce motion = it just appears.
_help.trailHold: Turn trails: how long the drawn trail holds before the glide and throw play, in seconds. trailLead + trailHold is how much slower each replayed turn is.

_labels.flightBase: Throw: time in the air (every throw)
_labels.flightPerHex: Throw: extra air time per hex
_labels.growFrom: Grow: starting size of the sprout
_labels.movePerHex: Move: extra glide time per hex
_labels.wordGlowTime: Words: clear time after a landing
_labels.trailHold: Trail: hold before the glide (online replays)
_labels.refreshPause: Refresh: pause between shrink and grow
